prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE new combined brand logo for the integrated Colombian logistics and SMS prevention project. Reference image 1 is the existing LogiPyme brand (package/check symbol and blue/navy/teal wordmark). Reference image 2 is the SafeSMS brand (chat bubble in purple circle). They are reference inputs, not objects to paste side by side.
Primary request: a polished, unified logo with a SINGLE simple emblem combining an isometric delivery box with a speech bubble and a subtle protective check, beside the two names in a balanced two-line wordmark.
Text EXACTLY: first line "LogiPyme", second line "+ SafeSMS". Preserve uppercase L and P in LogiPyme and uppercase S, S, M, S in SafeSMS. No other text, no tagline.
Style: clean flat vector-like logo, crisp geometric edges, professional and approachable SaaS identity, premium typography, robust at small UI sizes. Use navy #0B192C and royal blue #2563EB for logistics, a restrained purple #7C3AED chat accent, and a small teal #0D9488 check. Text primarily navy with blue/purple accents. The emblem must feel like one coherent mark, not a collage.
Composition: landscape rectangular logo asset, tight usable framing around the complete horizontal lockup; emblem left, aligned two-line names right. Minimal empty margins, no large square poster padding. Genuine transparent alpha background.
Avoid: photographs, 3D, mockups, shadows, glow, decorative rings, fine dotted lines, additional logos, extra words, duplicated marks, white or black background rectangles, checkerboard drawn into the image, watermarks.
